name: timeline
title: Timeline / Steps
description: A presentational ordered sequence for protocols, procedures, and step-by-step flows (RF-8), with vertical and horizontal orientations. Status can be explicit per step or derived from currentStep; complete/current/upcoming is conveyed through marker shape, screen-reader text, and aria-current=step rather than color alone. Supports partial step arrays for streaming consumers and configurable status labels for localization. Styled only with @didact/theme token utilities; no animation or interactive state.
